description: This file serves as a header file defining interfaces for the engine controller module, including function declarations for initialization, mock voltage setting, and state printing related to engine control in an embedded system project.

methods.name: getPinNameByAdcChannel
methods.description: Retrieves the pin name associated with a specific ADC hardware channel, formatting it into the provided buffer.

methods.name: initPeriodicEvents
methods.description: Initializes periodic events for the engine system, parameters depend on engine configuration.

methods.name: initEngineContoller
methods.description: Initializes the engine controller module with shared logging facilities.

methods.name: commonInitEngineController
methods.description: Performs common initialization steps for the engine controller.

methods.name: setMockVBattVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock voltage value for the vehicle's battery voltage, used likely for testing.

methods.name: setMockMapVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock manifold absolute pressure (MAP) voltage.

methods.name: setMockTpsVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock throttle position sensor voltage.

methods.name: setMockAfrVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock air-fuel ratio sensor voltage.

methods.name: setMockMafVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock mass air flow sensor voltage.

methods.name: setMockIatVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock intake air temperature sensor voltage.

methods.name: setMockCltVoltage
methods.description: Sets a mock coolant temperature sensor voltage.

methods.name: printCurrentState
methods.description: Outputs the current engine state information for debugging or logging purposes.
